scope: Three consumed development pairs; non-blind autonomous visual assessment, not independent or population preference

visual_review.method: All three six-arm sheets; full source-size learned and precorrection images; source detail checks. Label-visible autonomous judgment. No face/text coverage claim.

rows.observation: Snow scene: widespread yellow/cyan chroma mottling on column and roof, excessive blue/yellow fine-edge contrast. Source already has noise/fringing, precorrection amplifies it, learned stage worsens its salience. Geometry retained but unacceptable full-detail colour/noise amplification.

Fruit and blocks: strong visible grading, retained shapes/texture, but pale yellow background and green shadows/kiwi lack balanced appeal versus identity/simple. More contrast than precorrection alone does not establish film quality.

Daisies: coherent dark teal foliage and muted warm flower centres provide a plausible creative photographic alternative; petals and defocus retained. Preferred here for mood versus bland precorrection and simple saturation, not proof of physical-film authenticity.
